create_imagefolder_dataset: create an ImageFolder dataset from a directory path with optional transforms for self-supervised learning
get_image_paths_list: get a sorted list of image file paths from a directory using get_image_paths
load_image_by_index: load an image by index from an ImageFolder dataset using the getitem method
apply_img_transform: apply an image-level transform to the input image before the record-level transform in ImageFolder
get_dataset_length: get the total number of images in an ImageFolder dataset using the len method
